title: Audit PR4100’s free-word tensor lift on all four actual programs
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR4100's proposed lift needs formal noncommuting cancellation before substituting tensor powers. This independently audits that specific premise on the four actual PR4088 words and supplies a written proof for every positive multiplicity. Scalar coefficients stay fixed; `G-I` maps to `G^{⊗f}-I`. The original representation argument is credited predecessor work.

The separately written exact pullback checks 723 outputs × 4 providers × 2 orientations = **5,784 output functionals**, with **6,680 endpoint terms and zero surviving nonempty words**. Supplemental implementations check 24 F101 and 24 exact-rational dirty-input specializations. Actual-program mutations produce exact errors `(I-G59)x273` and `-3*x119`.

This is a **positive scoped algebra audit, no new κ**. It does not certify native realization, physical placement, precision, common-cover/tape cost, analytic assembly, recovery or the complete multiplication theorem.
